items.text: A blend of emo, screamo and post-rock from a Japanese band, and the one album they recorded with three guitarists.
items.why: Reception: 'praising the album's hybrid of emo, screamo, and post-rock'; Lead: 'the Japanese band Envy ... It is their only album recorded with three guitarists'.

items.text: Winter 2003 at Bazooka Japan Institute, Tokyo, Japan
items.why: Infobox 'Recorded: Winter 2003 at Bazooka Japan Institute, Tokyo, Japan'.

items.text: Level Plane, Rock Action, Temporary Residence
items.why: Infobox: 'Label: Level Plane Rock Action Temporary Residence (2008)'; Lead: 'released on August 18, 2003 on Level Plane Records'. The notes drop the '(2008)', so the later Temporary Residence issue reads as part of the original release.

items.text: Dairoku Seki (drums), Tetsuya Fukagawa (sequencer, vocals), Nobukata Kawai (guitar), Masahiro Tobita (guitar), Manabu Nakagawa (bass guitar), Daichi Takasugi (guitar)
items.why: Personnel lists exactly these six with these roles.

items.text: Guitarist Daichi Takasugi joined Envy before the album was created, and he left after the tour linked to it.
items.why: Lead: 'Daichi Takasugi joined before the creation of the album and left after the related tour.' Personnel: 'Daichi Takasugi – Guitar'.

items.text: Besides the six players, the credits name two more people: Takashi Kitaguchi for engineering and Tatsuya Kase for mastering the album.
items.why: Personnel: 'Takashi Kitaguchi – Engineering; Tatsuya Kase – Mastering'.

missed: That the album is sung in Japanese and runs just over an hour (Infobox 'Language: Japanese', 'Length: 1 : 02 : 58'), and that critics (AllMusic, Stylus, Punknews.org) were almost uniformly positive. listen_for is empty although the track list is in the pack.
